[[Anduin Wrynn|Anduin]] (son) }} King '''Varian Wrynn''' is the former and currently missing ruler of the human kingdom of [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Stormwind]], son of King [[Llane Wrynn]]. Following his disappearance, his 10-year-old son [[Anduin Wrynn|Anduin]] has been named ruler of Stormwind. Born to King Llane, Varian was a young child when his father was assassinated during the [[First War]]. [[Anduin Lothar]] served as Regent Lord of Stormwind during the flight to Lordaeron and the retaking of Stormwind during the [[Second War]]. Varian was instated as king when he reached the Age of Ascension, and served as the ruler of [[Stormwind]] during the rebuilding of the kingdom. He was one of the few rulers to provide continued support to the failing [[Alliance of Lordaeron]] following the end of the Second War. Varian Wrynn was abducted while traveling to [[Theramore]], in a plot involving the [[Defias]]. ==In World of Warcraft== Up until [[Patch 1.10.0]], he could be found on [[Alcaz Island]] near [[Theramore Isle]], where he was being held captive in a dungeon.
